summary: Day 17 of 72 (Time & Work 1: Total Work Units & Efficiency Ratios): Use the LCM method to assign total work units. Calculate individual and combined daily work rates.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Dedicated Job Outreach Application Batch
blocks.details: Dedicated morning batch: Submit 8–10 tailored applications on Instahyre and LinkedIn Jobs. Target Series A–C tech and European remote roles highlighting Immediate Joiner status.

blocks.title: CAT Day 17: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: 25 Questions on Time & Work basics: A and B work together, B is 50% more efficient than A, work completed in fractions.. DILR: Distribution Logic 2 (Grid assignment with multiple negative conditions: X cannot have Y or Z). Anastasis Set 13..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 17: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: CL MyZone VARC: RC Module 3 - Science & Evolutionary Biology passages. Solve 2 passages (8 Qs) in 18 mins. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
